purpose: Auditable static source for custom unit shooter/melee role facts used by no-compromise faction laws.
validationState: Static/source-authored only. These contracts are joined to exact ability_overrides sourceMechanicId and branchRole fields; they are not runtime proof that battle Unit payloads expose the same role.
rules: Every contract key must match an exact sourceMechanicId in custom_factions/ability_overrides/homm3_*.json.
Line-level contracts apply to all units with that exact sourceMechanicId unless a branchRoles override for the exact branchRole is present.
Use unknown when the current source contract does not explicitly settle shooter or melee behavior.
Do not infer roles from donor unit identity, SID substring, icon, prefab, animation folder, or faction-wide assumptions.
No role fact may feed promoted gameplay until generated Core rows and in-context runtime diagnostics prove the same custom unit identity reaches the consuming hook.
